name: Ferienwohnung Haus am Waldrand
beschreibung:
Situated directly at the forest's edge above Lake Thiersee, this holiday apartment promises undisturbed relaxation in untouched nature. The comfortably appointed rooms feature a lovely balcony overlooking alpine peaks.

Walking trails lead straight from the house into the mountains, while Lake Thiersee invites refreshing swims in summer.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Haus am Waldrand in Thiersee offers total tranquility and forest-edge seclusion in Kufsteinerland.
